title: Flatulence
description: Assert dominance without saying a word
body:
This mod gives players a chance to fart whenever they sneak, playing a sound audible to nearby players. Players near a fart accumulate "exposure"; once exposure reaches 100%, they're hit with Nausea and their exposure resets. It is **required** on the server. Clients that don't have it installed won't hear the fart sound, but will still see the fart particles and be affected by Nausea. ## Features ### 💨 Farts - Sneaking has a configurable chance to make a player fart - A cooldown limits how often the fart chance roll can trigger per player - Nearby players accumulate exposure with each fart they're close to - Once a player's exposure reaches 100%, they're hit with Nausea and their exposure resets ### 🤢 Exposure - Exposure accumulates per fart within a configurable radius - Exposure slowly decays over time as players catch some fresh air ### 🍖 Food Bonuses - Certain foods can temporarily increase a player's fart chance - Each food has a configurable bonus and decay rate - Eating the same food again refreshes the bonus _The truly dedicated may one day experience the Forbidden Fart_... ## Configuration
Settings Settings can be edited in-game via [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) if installed, or directly in `config/flatulence.json`. | Field | Default | Description | |--------------------------|:-------------:|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | `fartChance` | `0.3` (`30%`) | Chance per sneak that a player farts. | | `fartCooldownTicks` | `10` | Minimum time between fart chance rolls for the same player. | | `exposureRadius` | `5.0` | How close other players must be to gain exposure when someone farts, in blocks. | | `exposureIncrement` | `0.5` (`50%`) | How much a nearby player's exposure increases per fart. | | `exposureDecayPerSecond` | `0.1` (`10%`) | How much exposure decreases per second. | | `nauseaDurationSeconds` | `10` | How long Nausea lasts once a player's exposure reaches 100% (`1.0`). | | `foods` | `[]` | List of foods that temporarily boost fart chance. |
--- _Fart sounds by [Blackstar](https://www.myinstants.com/en/profile/Blackstar/uploaded/) and [Ilikebreathingair](https://www.myinstants.com/en/profile/ilikebreathingair/uploaded/)._ --- _**Note**: If you encounter any issues, please report them on the [GitHub Issues page](https://github.com/Pemiridosa/flatulence/issues)._
